acceptance: A repository can declare ACP and generate an unregistered policy proposal before endpoint or board bindings exist.
The local work ledger validates complete E0/E1 items and rejects active E2-E4 work.
The shared client uses a named endpoint set, selects only an endpoint that passes readiness and shared-state checks, and never retries valid denials or ambiguous state-changing requests.
Protected pushes, merges, deployments, policy or credential changes, and recovery continue to require a fresh exact ACP ALLOW.
The relevant Python tests pass and documentation describes the verified Vercel-only operating state.
evidenceRequirements: Run the repository's documented test commands for ACP client routing, initialization, project upgrades, and local work validation.
Record ACP report and snapshot unavailability without credentials; do not treat local validation as remote authorization.
exclusions: Do not push, merge, deploy, or change any GitHub issue or board state.
Do not change ACP policy, credentials, production state, or recovery grants.
Do not copy secrets or production database state into local or Preview environments.
objectiveOrHypothesis: Make local onboarding and E0/E1 work usable when ACP or the GitHub board is unavailable, while keeping protected effects fail-closed and requiring an exact live ACP ALLOW.
scope: Complete the existing outage-safe bootstrap and shared ACP endpoint-set implementation on this issue branch.
Keep Railway out of active endpoint defaults; use the documented Vercel endpoint and preserve endpoint-specific credentials and shared-state checks.
Validate new-project initialization, existing-project upgrades, local work item rules, and documentation against the same behavior.
stopConditions: Stop before any GitHub or Vercel write because this local item grants only E0/E1 permissions.
Stop if a schema, auth boundary, endpoint identity, or retry outcome cannot be verified from the repository contract.
Stop when the local acceptance checks pass or a required external authorization remains unavailable.
